title: 壁付けの露出型シャワーセット
description: 公共浴室やプール更衣室に配置する露出配管型シャワー。混合栓風の操作バー、上部散水ヘッド、スライドレール、手持ちヘッドと固定ホースを造形。緊急洗眼シャワーとは用途・構造が異なる浴室器具です。壁・水・内部弁、温度・流量制御や可動はなく、安全・衛生基準への適合は未検証。最低点基準から取付高さと壁離れを調整してください。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.446 × 1.642 × 0.565 m、18,216三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: An exposed shower set for public bathing rooms and pool changing facilities, with mixer-shaped control bar, overhead head, slide rail, handheld head and fixed hose. Its bathing purpose and construction differ from an emergency eyewash shower. Wall, water, internal valves, temperature/flow control and articulation are absent; safety and hygiene compliance are unvalidated. Adjust mounting height and wall offset from its lowest-point placement origin. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.446 × 1.642 × 0.565 m; 18,216 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
